title: Lead Platform Manager, Tech Foundations
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

 

Airbnb is a vision- and mission-driven company. Our Product Managers embody this culture and mindset. They imagine the ideal end state for our community (guests and hosts) and work backward from it, challenging current assumptions. They champion winning strategies, leverage metrics to track progress, and partner with talented cross-functional teammates (engineering, design, data science, and more). Highly hands-on, they are never afraid to roll up their sleeves to deliver the right outcome for our community. If you’re excited to help us create a world where anyone can belong anywhere, we’d love to meet you.

The Difference You Will Make

 

As a Lead Product Manager for Developer Productivity, you will own the product areas developers rely on, and you will own something harder: the end-to-end workflows that determine how productive our engineers actually are. Those workflows cross organizational boundaries - a single developer journey can touch other parts of the infrastructure, reliability, developer experience, and security. Your job is to understand the end-to-end developer journey, find where it breaks, and drive the work to fix it whether or not the fix lives in your teams.

You will define what developer productivity means at Airbnb, instrument it, and be accountable for moving it. In collaboration with business stakeholders, product marketing, and technical program managers, you will help shape the roadmap for these products, with an emphasis on bringing together disparate offerings into a cohesive infrastructure roadmap.This will include the creation and ownership of Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) to inform technical decisions. You will also partner with engineers, designers, data scientists, and field-operations teams to scale our solutions across existing and emerging business segments, ensuring a cohesive system view.

A Typical Day

 

• Establish product vision and northstar for your area, and connect it into the broader developer productivity strategy

• Own cross-cutting developer workflows end to end - mapping where they break across pillars like App & Cloud Infra, Reliability Engineering, and Developer Experience, and driving the changes that improve them

• Define how we measure developer productivity: build the metrics, instrumentation, and qualitative research that tell us whether engineers' lives are actually getting better

• Partner with Engineering, Product, TPM, and Data Science to understand goals and establish success criteria with clearly measurable objectives and key results

• Develop the product roadmap, and get alignment on prioritization and timelines to meet business goals

• Influence teams you don't own - build the case, bring the data, and get other groups to prioritize developer productivity work alongside their own roadmaps

• Develop a deep understanding of how Airbnb's engineers work day to day, and of the technical architecture underneath, to build and improve products that fit into real workflows rather than around them

• Execute efficiently to ship products and deliver impact for our business and users.

• Lead cross-functional groups to fulfill the team’s mission, acting as the system voice.

• Communicate concisely and influence outcomes at all levels of the organization, demonstrating strong executive presence.

Your Expertise

 

• 10+ years of product management experience building tools and platforms for technical users - developer tooling, infrastructure, or platform products

• Track record of improving developer o

title: BDR Team Manager | French Market (Paris)
description:
Chez Lexroom, nous ne construisons pas simplement un logiciel : nous transformons la façon dont les professionnels du droit travaillent.

Notre mission ?

Donner aux avocats, aux cabinets et aux entreprises un produit d'IA de classe mondiale qui fait gagner du temps, augmente la productivité et redéfinit ce qui est possible dans le monde juridique.

Devenir l'entreprise d'IA la plus innovante.

Construire le nouveau standard de la vente, l'école de référence de la vente B2B.

Nous changeons les règles du jeu, avec une équipe de rockstars en quête de leur prochain grand défi.

Pourquoi Lexroom ?

- Façonner l'avenir : rejoignez l'équipe qui mène la révolution de l'IA pour les professionnels du droit.

- Grandir entouré de rockstars : collaborez avec des talents de premier plan, dans un environnement qui valorise la créativité, l'ambition et la progression.

- Avoir un impact réel : votre travail influencera directement la manière dont les avocats exercent leur métier - plus efficacement, plus intelligemment.

Chez Lexroom, nous ne promettons pas seulement une évolution de carrière : nous promettons un parcours d'apprentissage, d'impact et de sens. Prêt·e à transformer le monde du droit ?

Vos responsabilités

Nous construisons la machine outbound qui définira la façon dont les équipes juridiques adoptent l'IA à grande échelle. En tant que BDR Team Manager, vous dirigerez et développerez une équipe de BDR chargée de générer du pipeline qualifié sur les segments Mid-Market/Enterprise et SMB, en lien étroit avec les AE, le Marketing et les Partnerships, avec un focus sur le marché français.

- Piloter la création de pipeline sur votre segment : objectifs de meetings tenus, SQL, pipeline qualifié en €, couverture et taux de conversion.

- Manager, coacher et faire grandir les BDR : 1:1 hebdomadaires, coaching d'appels, coaching sur les comptes et les deals, diagnostic des compétences, plans de performance. Relever le niveau sur la qualité, pas seulement sur l'activité.

- Construire un système outbound réplicable : affinage de l'ICP, frameworks de messaging, plays de multi-threading, account plans, séquences (email/téléphone/LinkedIn), traitement des objections et discipline du « next step ».

- Excellence opérationnelle : forecast de génération de pipeline, dashboards, contrôle qualité de l'hygiène CRM, boucles de feedback serrées avec les AE sur la qualité et le traitement des leads.

- Recrutement et onboarding : sourcer et interviewer les talents BDR, structurer le plan d'onboarding, piloter la montée en productivité avec des jalons clairs.

- Alignement transverse : transformer les retours du marché en inputs produit et marketing, coordonner les campagnes et les initiatives ABM, créer un handoff propre BDR → AE.

- Expérimentation et itération : tester messages, segments, canaux et séquences en A/B. Industrialiser ce qui marche, arrêter vite ce qui ne marche pas.

- Installer la culture : exigence élevée, ego bas, forte ownership. Les faits avant le ressenti (reporting propre, pas de sandbagging, pas de « happy ears »).

Ce que nous recherchons

- Expérience confirmée de management de BDR en SaaS B2B : des équipes construites et coachées qui atteignent des objectifs de pipeline, pas seulement des objectifs d'activité.

- Maîtrise de l'outbound Enterprise/Mid-Market : prospection par comptes, cartographie multi-interlocuteurs, multi-threading, messaging orienté valeur.

- Vraie qualité de coaching : savoir diagnostiquer l'origine d'une sous-performance (compétence, motivation, territoire ou messaging) et la corriger avec un plan.

- Profil data-driven : à l'aise avec les métriques de funnel, les leviers de conversion, la conception d'expérimentations et le management de la performance.

- Français courant (natif ou C1+) et anglais.

- Maîtrise des outils : CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot), outils de séquençage, Sales Navigator, avec une vraie discipline de reporting.

Ce que nous offrons

- 90 000 € OTE : 60 000 € fixe + 30 000 € varia

title: Project Engineer (Data Centres & Industrials)
description:
About the role
Octopus is building a new business line delivering low-cost, reliable, clean energy and faster speed-to-power for data centres and large industrials. We're looking for a Project Electrical Engineer to be the electrical owner on first-of-a-kind power projects - private wire, behind-the-meter generation and storage, MV and HV grid connections.
This is a technical role with a unique expanded scope to broader infrastructure project management. Early on you are the project manager: you hold the programme, the development budget and the external parties, from concept design through connection offer to design freeze and financial close. From there you stay on as the electrical owner through construction, commissioning and energisation, with a delivery team around you.
What you'll do

Own the programme and the development budget. Schedule from early concept to design freeze - siting, connection application, planning, consents, procurement, long-lead items - worked back from the customer's energisation date. Appoint and manage consultants, ICPs and study providers. Surface risk early and clearly communicate them to the stakeholders.

Own the electrical concept through to sign-off. Single-line diagrams, general arrangements, switchgear and plant layouts, cable routes, metering and comms architecture. Direct and interrogate the studies (load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, earthing, power quality). Chair design reviews and stage gates, and take options to the Project Lead and customer with a recommendation.

Lead the grid interface. DNO, TO and NESO - applications and offers, technical requirements, securities and milestones, contestable and non-contestable scope, ICP/IDNO coordination, MPAN registration.

title: Orbital Analyst
locationText: Costa Mesa, California, United States; Remote
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB
As an Orbital Analyst, Space Ground Systems, you will support key day-to-day processes such as: technical support for observatory operations, configuring edge compute  capabilities within Windows and Linux and assisting with satellite tracking data analysis. This role is integral in maintaining the accuracy, completeness and integrity of
the Anduril space object catalog and the derived products meet established customer standards.

This hands-on operations and analysis role is centered on catalog maintenance, data curation and quality assurance. Success depends on attention to detail, disciplined
process and clear communication with fellow analysts as well as across the business line.

THIS ROLE IS A CONTRIBUTOR ON A TEAM THAT OPERATES 24/7. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Contribute to monitoring and analysis of global telescope network operations

• Identify knowledge articles and SOPs for network operations.

• Triage issues, root cause failures, and coordinate next-steps.

• Create and analyze metrics that are leveraged for debugging and monitoring.

• Contribute to software solutions to increase efficiency.

• Partner with end-users to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Engineering background from industry or school, ideally in areas/fields such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics.

• Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and detailed requirements.

• Capable of solving complex technical problems with little oversight.

• Clear communication and organizational skills including documentation and training material.

• Comfort working in a monitoring and operations environment that may include shift, on-call and/or extended hours coverage.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with orbital mechanics and characteristics of satellite orbit regimes.

• Familiarity with space domain awareness concepts, space object catalogs and/or conjunction/maneuver analysis.

• Exposure to telescope, or other phenomenology, observation data.

• At least 3+ years working with a variety of programming languages such as Java, Python, C++, Rust, Go, JavaScript, etc.

• A desire to work on critical software in the space domain.

• Be prepared to discuss shift availability for a 24/7 team.

$132,000 — $198,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying. 
Welocalize is looking for a native-level Spanish (Spain) speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About us

SwimOutlet is the largest online specialty retailer for swimming and water sports in the US, and part of Spiraledge, whose brands include EverydayYoga, Swim.com, Practyce and Tend. We are a small marketing team running more than ten million dollars a year of paid media in house across about ten channels, and we move fast.

The role

You own SwimOutlet's organic social presence end to end, and you own the production of our social and paid social creative. Publishing and scheduling are part of it, and so is repurposing what we already have. We are looking for a maker: someone who shoots and edits video, produces UGC, cuts motion graphics and builds statics, and who can make content that is authentically of the swim world and content that actually sells product. Knowing the difference between those two things is most of the job.

You will have internal design and digital media support and a freelance budget to extend your capacity. The output is still yours.

You will also run our ambassador program as a measurable channel, manage community, and work weekly with the CMO on the paid content pipeline.

You will not buy media or run the ad accounts; our paid media team does that. You will be expected to read the results with us every week and change what you make because of them.

What you will own

Content production

• Make the work. You are our primary producer of social and paid social creative across short-form video, UGC, motion graphics and statics.

• Shoot and edit on demand and on location, including on a pool deck and at meets, around launches and campaign moments.

• Produce a consistent pipeline of testable creative for Meta and our other paid social channels, agreeing weekly with the CMO on what to make next.

• Direct and produce UGC through our ambassador roster and creator network.

• Publish and schedule across our channels. This is a hands-on role and posting is part of it.

• Repurpose what we already have into new formats and placements: cutting longer footage into shorts, reworking UGC into paid ads, adapting statics across surfaces.

• Use our internal designers, the digital media team and external freelancers to extend your capacity. They support the output, you own it.

• Use AI tools wherever they genuinely speed things up: ideation, scripting, editing, and image or video generation.

Channel strategy and operations

• Own SwimOutlet's and our private label Sporti's organic social presence end to end across prioritized channels: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts.

• Run a full audit of our branded social channels in your first 60 days and recommend what to prioritize, maintain or sunset.

• Operate those channels to a high standard: planning, production, publishing, community management and performance tracking.

• Manage Tolstoy shoppable video for on-site and retention relevance.

Creative testing and performance

• Lead creative ideation and testing for paid social: hooks, angles, copy, formats.

• Meet weekly with the CMO to review paid creative performance and agree what to produce more of.

• Own creative-side performance analysis: CTR, CPM, thumbstop rate, hook rate, hold rate, engagement rate and outbound CTR.

• Turn that analysis into clear calls on which angles and formats to double down on.

Community and ambassador program

• Run the ambassador program as a measurable channel, including UGC and influencer sourcing within it.

• Recruit, brief, track output and evaluate ROI per ambassador, and refine the roster toward the highest-value partners.

• Manage community engagement across DMs, comments and tagged content.

• Escalate anything sensitive on PR, CX or legal with good judgement about what needs to come to the CMO.

Product and merchandising alignment

• Keep a clear feed of prioritization inputs from the buying and planning teams so social reflects business priorities.

• Surface priority products, launches and promotional moments through our existing marketing meeting

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. You will serve as the hands-on technical bridge between autonomy algorithms and physical aircraft systems, working across Shield AI and aircraft platform vendors to verify system interfaces, validate edge compute performance, and resolve integration issues before flight testing.

title: Senior ML Research Scientist – AI & Generative Recommendation (m/f/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads, sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world's smartphones, connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem.

Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Scalable Discovery & Engagement

The Data Science Research team builds foundational ML representations and advanced AI capabilities that enhance both Playtime and adjoe Ads. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI and deep learning approaches-specifically generative approaches -to deliver critical systems such as high-dimensional user embeddings, general content understanding and sequential recommendation. These frameworks scale adjoe's products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users.

The team operates at the intersection of bleeding-edge R&D and high-scale production engineering, acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser and primary consulting layer for complex ML bottlenecks. The stack is optimized for deep learning and heavy data throughput: PyTorch and [Ray/Hugging Face] for training and fine-tuning foundation models, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure for heavy workloads. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team-from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain high-throughput, realtime production environments.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

- PhD or equivalent research depth, with a production track record. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics, or an MSc with extensive industry research, and publications in top-tier venues like SIGIR, KDD, NeurIPS, or ICLR. You've spent 4+ years building large-scale recommender systems in high-throughput environments: AdTech, e-commerce, or social.

- You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. At adjoe, that means architecting multi-stage recommendation pipelines, Generative Retrieval, Deep Ranking, and Re-ranking, serving millions of requests across a stack built on 770 million users' behavioral data.

- Deep expertise in PyTorch and large-scale model optimization. You have hands-on experience with high-concurrency optimization, model quantization, and distillation, the engineering side of getting large generative models to run under extreme production constraints, not just in research environments.

- Content understanding and embeddings are core to your work. You research and develop information-rich user and ad embeddings using unsupervised and generative approaches, directly improving the quality of predictions across both Playtime and adjoe Ads.

- Raises the technical bar around them. You lead architectural debates, mentor junior scientists, and drive the team's research direction without needing a roadmap handed to you.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

- Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

- Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

title: Backend Engineer

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart operates at the intersection of food access, gig economy labor, and marketplace regulation, making legislative and regulatory engagement a core business function, not an afterthought. As the regulatory landscape around gig economy platforms, marketplace operators, and labor practices continues to evolve rapidly, the Legislative and Labor Team needs a skilled lawyer to analyze emerging requirements, build compliance frameworks, and shape the regulatory conversation before it shapes Instacart. Without this role, gaps in legal analysis and compliance strategy could create operational risk across multiple areas of the business. A year from now, Instacart will have stronger legal frameworks in place, clearer compliance strategies across regulatory domains, and a more coordinated voice in the cross-industry conversations that define the rules of the road for the gig economy.

• Cross-functional regulatory responses are coordinated with clarity: Policy and Government Affairs, Operations, Product, and Communications teams have a consistent, well-analyzed legal perspective on legislative matters affecting Instacart's operations.

• Legal frameworks and compliance best practices for meeting legislative and regulatory mandates are developed and documented, giving the company a foundation to navigate evolving requirements with confidence.

• Instacart's relationships with external counsel, trade associations, and industry partners are actively managed, with cross-industry initiatives underway that contribute to shaping the regulatory conversation in favor of gig economy innovation.

• Expertise in emerging areas of law relevant to Instacart's business is built and shared internally, ensuring the team is prepared to respond to new legal challenges as they arise.

 

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

• Juris Doctor (JD) degree.

• 3+ years of experience practicing law.

• Demonstrated ability to synthesize, analyze, and provide precise legal advice in response to legislative updates.

• Experience working with legislative bodies, government agencies, or regulatory matters.

• Proven success in supporting compliance initiatives and executing legal frameworks.

• Understanding of legislative processes and the regulatory landscape.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience with legislative or regulatory strategy.

• Familiarity with issues facing marketplace platform companies, gig economy platform companies, or similarly highly regulated businesses

About Us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a true startup Operations person. Good onboarding is what makes our merchants set up for success. From the first meeting, the go-live to working and growing together - this person will own the onboarding process and make it all happen. This role is for someone who likes working with the product, becoming an expert in it and teaching others.

Your day-to-day will be a mix of hands-on ops, project management, customer communication and problem solving. We are reshaping the future of hospitality tech, and this role is at the forefront of it.

What You’ll Do:

Our Operations happen on a restaurant floor, in a lively neighbourhood, at a busy bar - we operate in the city:

- Run restaurant onboarding: train, connect and implement together with the restaurant team

- Problem-solve for our merchants on the ground while running live operations

- Support restaurants for the first month after the go live

- Find opportunities for improvement in our process, materials and systems

- Identify product and process gaps and bring it to internal central teams such as product, engineering and central operations

What You’ll Need:

- You are a creative problem solver who enjoys interacting with hospitality businesses

- You are empathetic towards our merchants and curious about their business

- You can juggle multiple things at once and bring structure

- Curious about the product, want to be an expert in Tebi system and can apply your knowledge

- Good communication - you are great at proactive contact and managing expectations

- Being comfortable with high-pace environments: both the hospitality flow and the startup day-to-day

- Flexibility in working hours to fit our merchants’ needs

- At least 1-2 years of experience in hospitality, early startup operations, fast-paced account management or customer operations

- You are comfortable working in both German and English

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careershttps://www.tebi.com/de/careers https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Flexible Time-off

- Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Do you have a passion for network engineering technologies?
Are you looking for the freedom to innovate and help shape the next generation of the network?
Join our Network Engineering team!
The Network Engineering team designs, automates, and supports the global network powering Akamai's products and services. Using advanced technologies, the team ensures optimal connectivity and performance for customers and the compute platform.
Partner with the best
As a Senior Network Engineer, you will lead efforts in designing, implementing, and automating a global network infrastructure. You will address complex issues in routing, data center fabrics, and automation to ensure scalability, reliability, and security. This role involves driving the evolution of network infrastructure, from initial architecture through to implementation.
As a Senior Network Engineer, you will be responsible for:

• Designing, building, and maintaining our global network infrastructure.

• Developing and maintaining Akamai's core network configuration templates using Jinja2.

• Implementing new hardware platforms and network features within the automation framework.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define data models and functional requirements.

• Serving as a subject matter expert for complex network issues, performing deep-dive troubleshooting and analysis.

• Creating and maintaining clear documentation & procedures.

Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:

• Have relevant experience and a Bachelor's in computer science or equivalent experience.

• Demonstrate extensive experience in IP network design and implementation of scalable BGP routing architecture.

• Understand Data Center architecture, including CLOS Fabric and overlay technologies such as VxLAN and EVPN.

• Have experience in managing and troubleshooting multi-vendor environments like Juniper, Cisco & routing platforms like BIRD, FRR and Cumulus.

• Understand of end-to-end data flows and traffic patterns.

• Develop and manage network configuration templates utilizing automation tools like Python, Ansible, and Jinja2 effectively and efficiently.

About us
At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
Our focus is simple:
Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery : Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI : Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.
Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.
FlexBase adapts to your job's needs
Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.
Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

title: Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Platform

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at Deliveroo and DoorDash, leading the design and architecture of our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You'll set technical direction across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability, and mentor engineers as you go. This role is ideal for a senior engineer who enjoys owning ambiguous, high-impact systems

• Frontend programming experience in Typescript/Javascript

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

description:
У команду фіксованого зв’язку Київстар шукаємо фахівця/чиню, що відповідатиме за збільшення абонентської бази в своїй зоні відповідальності шляхом забезпечення ефективної візуалізації, безпосередніх продажів та участі в спеціальних активностях.

Розглядаємо кандидатів і з наближених міст регіону: Трускавця, Стебника, Борислава, Стрия та Нового Роздолу. Позиція передбачає роз'їзний характер роботи по даних населених пунктах.
Що треба робити?
Збільшувати абонентську базу на закріпленій території
Організовувати локальні маркетингові (BTL, D2D, CC та ін) та BTL-заходи разом із партнерами
Продзвонювати базу потенційних абонентів і проводити прямі продажі
Забезпечувати якісну візуалізацію та оновлювати POSM-матеріали згідно зі стандартами
Готувати щомісячний план оновлення візуалізації спільно з СПП на своїй території
Надавати пропозиції щодо адрес розміщення додаткових матеріалів (таблички на під’їзди, дошки оголошень тощо)
Аналізувати ринок, виявляти активності конкурентів і надавати зворотний зв’язок
Ви - наш метч, якщо…
Маєте освіту не нижче середньої спеціальної (технікум), а вища буде чудовим бонусом
Володієте досвідом роботи від 2 років у сфері продажів або обслуговування
Вільно орієнтуєтеся на телекомунікаційному ринку та розумієте принципи надання інтернет-послуг
Добре знаєте свою зону відповідальності та вмієте розробляти локальні BTL-активності
Впевнено плануєте продажі й працюєте з програмами MS Office, зокрема в Excel
Буде круто, якщо…
Маєте досвід роботи у телекомунікаціях
Вільно володієте навичками оперативної локалізації продажів та побудови маршрутів
Маєте посвідчення водія категорії «В»
Чому Київстар?
Гнучкий графік роботи, гібридний формат
Бонуси за досягнення цілей (річні чи квартальні - залежить від ролі)
340+ внутрішніх курсів, власна бібліотека, навчальні програми від партнерів
Страхування життя і здоров’я
Програми підтримки працівників та їхніх родин: психологічні, юридичні та ін
Безбар’єрний простір для роботи та розвитку
Проєкти на підтримку захисників, ветеранів та їхніх родин
Компенсація витрат на мобільний зв’язок
Готові до нових, масштабних проєктів? Надсилайте резюме 😉t

title: Leiter Konzernrechnungswesen (m/w/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena digitalisiert die Hausverwaltung in Deutschland. Wir übernehmen traditionelle Hausverwaltungen und transformieren sie in moderne, technologiegetriebene Unternehmen, mit dem Ziel, Immobilienverwaltung einfach und transparent zu machen.

DEINE ROLLE

Du baust unser Rechnungswesen von Grund auf. Du entwickelst die Prozesse, gestaltest die Systeme und stellst Schritt für Schritt ein schlankes Team zusammen. Dabei arbeitest du selbst operativ mit und verantwortest korrekte HGB-Abschlüsse für alle Gesellschaften und für die Gruppe. Du berichtest direkt an den CFO. Unsere Gruppe wächst durch Zukäufe, und was du aufbaust, muss mit diesem Tempo mithalten. Du entscheidest, wie Rechnungswesen bei Buena funktioniert.

WAS DU TUN WIRST

- Aufbau. Du baust ein zentrales Rechnungswesen für alle deutschen Gesellschaften Schritt für Schritt auf. Dafür legst du Zielbild und Roadmap fest, übernimmst Aufgaben von externen Dienstleistern und steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit ihnen.

- Prozesse. Du setzt einheitliche Prozesse von der Kreditorenbuchhaltung bis zum Jahresabschluss auf, inklusive festem Abschlusskalender, und reduzierst manuelle Schritte.

- Integration neuer Gesellschaften. Du baust die Systeme und Prozesse, mit denen wir neu erworbene Gesellschaften schnell und präzise integrieren.

- Systeme. Du verantwortest DATEV und LucaNet und gestaltest Datenmodell, Kontenplan, Mapping, Validierungen und Berechtigungen.

- Einzelabschlüsse. Du prüfst die Einzelabschlüsse aller Gesellschaften auf Richtigkeit und Termintreue, damit sie eine belastbare Basis für die Konsolidierung sind. Wo nötig, übernimmst du Abschlussbuchungen, Abstimmungen und Intercompany-Klärungen selbst.

- Konsolidierung. Du baust die HGB-Konsolidierung in LucaNet auf, mit monatlichen Konzernzahlen, die einer Prüfung standhalten, sowie Konzernkontenplan und Bilanzierungsrichtlinien.

- Prüfer und Berater. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Wirtschaftsprüfer und Steuerberater und setzt Prüfungsfeststellungen um.

- Team. Du baust das Team Schritt für Schritt auf und entscheidest, welche Aufgaben intern bleiben und welche extern vergeben werden.

DU PASST GUT ZU UNS, WENN

- Du hast Konzernabschlüsse nach HGB selbst erstellt, nicht nur koordiniert oder geprüft, am besten in einer Gruppe mit vielen Gesellschaften.

- Du bist LucaNet-Experte und hast eine Konsolidierung dort selbst neu aufgesetzt, von der Datenübernahme aus DATEV bis zum Reporting.

- Du beherrschst DATEV bis in die Tiefe und hast viele Mandanten mit einheitlicher Struktur aufgesetzt und geführt.

- Du hast ein Rechnungswesen mit Prozessen und Systemen selbst aufgebaut, nicht nur verbessert.

- Du hast ein Team aufgebaut und geführt.

- Du erkennst Fehler in Einzelabschlüssen, bevor sie in die Konsolidierung laufen.

- Du warst bei Abschlussprüfungen erste Ansprechperson und hast Feststellungen umgesetzt.

- Du arbeitest schnell und genau, auch unter Abschlussdruck.

- Du kommst in unklaren Situationen schnell ins Handeln.

- Du entwirfst Lösungen und setzt sie selbst um, ohne auf Vorlagen oder Zuarbeit zu warten.

- Du hast BWL, Rechnungswesen oder Finanzen studiert oder bist vergleichbar qualifiziert. Bilanzbuchhalter, Steuerfachwirt, Steuerberater oder Prüfer sind ein Vorteil.

- Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und gut Englisch.

WAS DU BEKOMMST

- Bis zu €500 Office-Nähe-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10-20 Gehminuten zum Office wohnst (oder hinziehst).

- €110 pro Monat Mittagessen-Budget und €50 pro Monat Fitness-Zuschuss.

- €1.200 jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

- Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

title: Intern, Quantum Applications
description:
PsiQuantum ’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers-machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.
Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.
Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry-including partners like GlobalFoundries-we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.
In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining-and that now is the time to scale.
PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies-including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical-to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.
Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift-and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real.
Come join us.
Job Summary:
We are looking for enthusiastic candidates interested in applying quantum computing to real-world challenges. At PsiQuantum , we are particularly focused on use cases of quantum computing in chemistry, drug design, materials science, and fluid dynamics. Along these lines, we are offering internships in the areas of quantum algorithms and quantum compilation.
Your work could entail the -

• Development of quantum algorithms to solve impactful problems,

• Optimization of ubiquitous subroutines in fault tolerant quantum algorithms,

• Compilation of quantum algorithms to logical gate sets,

• Incorporation of architecture-aware optimizations,

• Estimation of quantum resources.

Prior work in the field of fault tolerant quantum algorithms and compilation is preferred, but enthusiasm for quantum computing is essential.
Desired experience and skills:

• Currently studying for, or completed a postgraduate degree related to quantum algorithms, quantum circuit compilation, fault tolerance or another aspect of quantum computing OR 5+ years working professionally in one or more of these fields.

• Experience with programming languages (e.g. Python) and collaborative software development tools (e.g. Git).

• A creative and adaptable approach to problem solving.

• Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative team.

Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.
We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!
About the Role
As Director of Analytics, you will own the full path from raw data to decision: the data warehouse, the transformation layer, and the BI tooling analysts and the business actually touch. You will set the technical direction for the analytics stack, lead a small team of analysts and analytics engineers, and be the person executive stakeholders come to for a straight answer backed by solid numbers.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will manage the team, but you are also expected to review models, dig into the warehouse yourself, and make the tooling calls, not just delegate them.
What We Are Looking For

• You are a rigorous thinker who treats data as evidence, not decoration, and holds your team to that same standard

• You have strong technical chops in SQL and the modern data stack (warehouse, transformation layer, BI layer), and you can go deep on any of them

• You have led or grown a team of analysts or analytics engineers, and you know how to hire, mentor, and set a bar

• You are comfortable owning ambiguous, open-ended problems, from "what should we even be measuring" through to a shipped dashboard

• You communicate findings crisply to technical and non-technical audiences, including at the executive level

• You have opinions on BI tooling grounded in experience, not just familiarity, and can make a real build-vs-buy or migrate-vs-stay case

What You Will Be Doing

•
Own the analytics architecture end to end , from the Snowflake warehouse and dbt transformation layer through to the BI/reporting layer used across the business

•
Set and evolve BI tooling strategy , including evaluating whether our current tool, Sigma, remains the right fit versus alternatives like Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, or Mode as the team and data volume grow

•
Lead, hire, and develop a team ofanalysts and analytics engineers

•
Partner with Product, Customer Success, and Engineering to define key metrics, build self-serve reporting, and translate business questions into well-scoped analytical work

•
Establish data modeling standards, testing, and governance across dbt models so the numbers hold up under scrutiny

•
Own data security and access controls across the warehouse and BI layer, ensuring sensitive retail, store, and operational data is properly governed, access is scoped by role, and we meet our customers' data handling requirements

•
Build and own executive-facing reporting on core business metrics such as product availability, store performance, and inventory accuracy

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in analytics, with at least 3 years directly managing or leading a team

• Deep hands-on SQL, including complex CTEs, window functions, and query optimization

• Real experience running a cloud data warehouse, Snowflake strongly preferred

• Hands-on experience with dbt or a comparable transformation layer

• Track record evaluating, migrating, or scaling BI tools, with the ability to speak concretely to tradeoffs between tools like Sigma, Looker, Tableau, and Power BI

• Experience translating messy operational data into decisions executives act on

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence cross-functional partners without authority

• Comfortable operating remote-first, across a distributed team

description:

•
Integrity: Our purpose guides our actions and gives us confidence in the path ahead. With unwavering honesty and dependability, we embrace the pressure of challenging the old and exemplify ethical leadership to create the new.

•
Courage: We face continuous challenges with grit and resilience. We embrace the discomfort of the unknown by balancing autonomy with empathy, and ownership with vulnerability. We boldly challenge the status quo to keep moving forward-always.

•
Together: The success of SmithRx reflects the strength of our partnerships and the commitment of our team. Our shared values bind us together and make us one. When one falls, we all fall; when one rises, we all rise.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a highly strategic Growth Specialist to design the foundational go-to-market (GTM) playbooks supporting our Enterprise team. Rather than executing standard outbound volume, this role requires deep independent judgment to evaluate, and implement advanced AI powered growth strategies.
As a founding member of our growth team, you will design the operational playbooks, test automated frameworks, and act as a strategic partner alongside internal marketing leadership and external advisors to drive SmithRx ’s growth engine.

• 3-4 years of experience in Sales, or growth marketing; enterprise healthcare or employer benefits experience (PBM, health plan, digital health) is a plus.

description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.

Our Communications team includes media relations, employee communications, community building, events, and other external-facing functions. This team’s ethos is to support OpenAI's mission and goals by clearly and authentically explaining our technology, values, and approach to safely building powerful AI.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced communications professional to help share how OpenAI builds and deploys technology responsibly in the real world. This person will play a key role in communicating about our safety work: how we prepare, respond thoughtfully when issues arise, and continue earning people’s trust as our systems become more capable.

This person will partner across teams to shape clear, confident narratives that show our commitment to transparency and continuous improvement. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys translating complex ideas into relatable stories, and sees opportunity in helping people understand how safety and innovation work together.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days per week in the office and offer relocation support.

In this role, you will:

- Develop communications strategies that highlight our proactive real-world safety practices and reinforce public confidence in how we approach responsible AI

- Craft thoughtful, timely responses when questions or issues emerge, helping audiences understand what we’re doing and why

- Prepare materials including statements, FAQs, and backgrounders that make complex information clear and credible

- Partner closely with cross-functional teams to anticipate emerging topics and build readiness plans

- Build and strengthen relationships with journalists covering AI safety, technology, and policy

- Provide calm, trusted counsel to leaders and teammates on sensitive or fast-moving narratives

- Help establish clear processes for monitoring external narratives and responding with empathy, accuracy, and care

You might thrive in this role if you:

- 10+ years of professional PR and media relations experience; corporate and/or crisis communications experience is preferred, in-house experience is a plus.

- Experience with AI technologies or a strong personal interest in AI.

- Exceptional ability to translate complex technical information into clear, persuasive external-facing content.

- Proven success in building relationships and collaborating with press, executives, partners, and other stakeholders.

- You’re energized by translating technical work into stories that people understand and care about

- You bring clear thinking, good judgment, and calm focus to high-profile projects

- You value precision and accountability, but can also think creatively about framing and narrative

- You want to be part of a team helping to shape how the world understands safe and responsible AI
